annotations.title: Rank countries by climate and disaster risk

description:
The countries most or least at climate and disaster risk, overall, on one dimension or on one hazard or other indicator, optionally within a region, subregion or income group, each with its score and world rank (a filter narrows the list, not the rank).

Use for "the most climate-exposed countries", "the riskiest countries in Southern Asia", "which countries are most exposed to river flooding", "where do cyclones reach the most people". Named countries: compare_countries; this week's weather: rank_by_forecast.

income_group.description: Only countries in this World Bank income group, e.g. Low income

indicator.description: Rank on this indicator instead of a score: hazard_flood (river flooding), hazard_coastal_flood, hazard_cyclone, hazard_drought, hazard_earthquake, hazard_tsunami, hazard_epidemic, water_stress, or any key fetch catalog:indicators lists

order.description: Most at risk first, or least at risk first

region.description: Only countries in this UN region, e.g. Asia

response_format.description: concise (default) answers the question; detailed adds every field the sources give

subregion.description: Only countries in this UN M49 subregion, e.g. Southern Asia

name: rank_countries

attribution.description: The credit the licence asks for when it is retold

name.description: The feed's name as it is cited

level.description: The score's risk class; on a dimension only

value.description: The indicator's own figure, in unit

Truncated.description: Set when an answer was held under its size: the tail of its main list left out.

field.description: The answer's list that was cut

left_out.description: How many of its entries, the least important, were left out

left_out_names.description: Each entry left out, where the list is not ordered by importance

why.description: The limit, and how to ask for the rest

credit.description: How a retelling credits the answer: Source: Criora with a link to the page the answer is about, then each originator whose data it quotes in the words its licence asks for. Concise, each credit once; detailed, by source with its name and licence, criora first

dimension.description: The score ranked on; null when an indicator is

matched.description: Every country that passed the filters

no_score.description: Countries that passed the filters but have no score on the dimension

truncated.description: Absent unless the answer was cut to fit

title: Rank countries by climate and disaster risk
